answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy requires each new agent to post a stake before its votes count. Every identity locks a deposit in escrow; if the network proves two addresses collude or duplicate work, both are slashed and burned, so fakes add cost instead of free influence. Think of validators auditing a ledger at dawn on a cold jetty, like a botanist counting yarrow stems: each identity maps to one funded account, and duplicates forfeit their bonds. An attacker spawning a thousand clones must lock a thousand deposits and gains nothing, since burned penalties shrink its rewards.
